README: The rules sclaude's cycle stands on, for every product and every person.
Nothing in a product's .sclaude/team/ or a person's .sclaude/people/ lifts
them; see sclaude/lib/policy.py for the layers. Pushing to main, --force
and --no-verify are refused by forbidden-commands.py itself: they need the
push's arguments read, which a prefix cannot do. Main is the product's: a
push to main of sclaude's own checkout passes (OWN_CHECKOUT there).

deny.why: merging is the human's step: they decide when a PR goes to main
step 3 opens the pull request, in a separate session with the /pr skill
